objective: Defeat enemies and progress through the stage.
rules: When a nearby entity has threatHint IncomingAttack, prefer DodgeAway or Retreat.
Approach enemies with Move when they are far away.
Use close-range attacks only after reaching attack range.
Use only actions listed in availableActions.
output: Create or update generated/debug_ai/behavior_plan.json for generated AI output. Use resources/debug_ai files only as editable templates.
